errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос показва различните години, като обхванатите са 2016, 2017, 2018 и 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis does not show years. It shows geographical regions: "Общо за страната", "Северозападен...", "Видин", "Враца", "Ловеч", "Монтана", and "Плевен". The years are represented by the different colored bars within each regional group, as indicated by the legend.

errors.text_span: най-високият стълб е бил за 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The tallest bar in the chart is for the year 2019 (purple bar) in the "Общо за страната" category, not 2018.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени по ред отляво надясно според годината.
errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart. The primary arrangement on the x-axis is by region. Within each regional group, the bars are ordered by year. The description incorrectly states that the overall ordering is by year.
The description completely omits the labels on the x-axis, which are the different geographical regions being compared.
The description fails to mention the fundamental grouping structure of the chart, i.e., that bars are grouped by geographical region.

The description of the legend is incomplete. It correctly identifies blue for 2016 but fails to specify the colors for the other years (2017-red, 2018-green, 2019-purple), simply stating they are "in different colors".
